title: custom-cc vars
description: Configuration variables for the Custom C Compiler (custom-cc) recipe

CUSTOM_CC_VERSION.description: Version identifier for the custom C compiler.

CUSTOM_CC_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Installation strategy for custom-cc ('local_binary' registers an existing binary, 'from-source' compiles custom-cc from source, 'libscript_native' downloads an archive, 'pkg_mgr' uses a package manager, 'wrapper' creates a self-test telemetry wrapper).

CUSTOM_CC_PKG_MGR.description: Specific package manager if installing custom-cc from a custom tap or repository.

CUSTOM_CC_BUILD_TOOLCHAIN.description: Host C toolchain used to compile custom-cc itself when CUSTOM_CC_INSTALL_METHOD='from-source' (e.g., 'default', 'gcc', 'clang', 'tcc', or self-hosting 'custom-cc').

CUSTOM_CC_BIN.description: Filesystem path to a prebuilt custom C compiler binary.

CUSTOM_CC_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: URL for downloading a custom C compiler source or binary archive.

CUSTOM_CC_GIT_URL.description: Git repository URL for building custom-cc from source.

CUSTOM_CC_BUILD_CMD.description: Command used to build custom-cc from source.

CUSTOM_CC_EXTRA_CFLAGS.description: Additional CFLAGS appended by the custom-cc wrapper.

CUSTOM_CC_STRIP_GNU_FLAGS.description: Whether cc_wrapper should strip GCC/Clang-specific warning and hardening flags unsupported by minimal C compilers.

CUSTOM_CC_FALLBACK_CC.description: Optional fallback C compiler binary invoked when custom-cc encounters unsupported GNU extensions or when running in CI wrapper mode.

CUSTOM_CC_FALLBACK_ON_ERROR.description: Whether cc_wrapper should retry failed compilation units with CUSTOM_CC_FALLBACK_CC and record fallback telemetry.
